findings.text: blocking: The required elapsed < 20 assertion has become elapsed < 900 over two passes, and PARAGRAPHS fell from 9000 to 2000; parse-count bounds permit a 21- or 100-second pass to remain green, and the recorded 101.479-second base refusal therefore does not validate the final same-home performance gate; restore the authorized timing measure and matched base/head evidence before landing.

non-blocking: The two-slot reference case expects launched=[] and two refused verdicts, so a change that prevents every otherwise-valid launch can survive this equivalence test; fold a successful-launch positive control into node an-admission-pass-decides-within-its-budget.

non-blocking: cold_parses <= plan_files and warm_parses == 0 both accept an instrument that observes zero parses, while line 238 checks phases seeded before execution and cannot prove requests were judged; fold a known-present cold-parse assertion into node an-admission-pass-decides-within-its-budget.

non-blocking: _swept_documents duplicates readiness.py:49's capability of fingerprinting documents for verdict-cache invalidation without extending it, adding a second traversal and identity policy; fold a shared owner with the stronger per-file identity into node an-admission-pass-decides-within-its-budget.

item_verdicts.manifest: The source run's manifest.md names six deliverable commits and completed baseline/head logs, but its landing line still describes the deleted head-only reader and quotes a 1.12-second result from an earlier head rather than the revision reviewed.

justifications.fit: reckon/crew/plan_review.py:6567 now wraps the repository's semantic reader and the added production names describe their mechanism, but its comment at :6677 still claims metadata avoids body parsing although the helper calls read_state_file.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/admission/selection.py:137-147 avoids a repeated stable sweep and plan_review.py:6567 delegates metadata to its semantic owner, but tests/test_an_admission_pass_decides_within_its_budget.py:232 no longer establishes the required 20 seconds.
